title: Taiwan's premier tells agencies to remain vigilant against anticipated cyberattacks ahead of elections
date_note: Remarks made at the weekly Cabinet meeting on Thursday 26 November, relayed by Cabinet spokesperson Michelle Lee.
summary: Premier Cho Jung-tai urged the relevant authorities to remain vigilant against anticipated cyberattacks ahead of the elections, Focus Taiwan reports, relaying Cabinet spokesperson Michelle Lee. He told the Ministry of Digital Affairs, the Central Election Commission and local election commissions to stay in close contact and coordinate their responses.
plain: Taiwan's premier asked election and digital-affairs authorities to stay alert for cyberattacks and coordinate before the elections.
exec: Taiwan's Cabinet has told its election and digital-affairs bodies to prepare for expected cyberattacks around the elections.
geo_basis: The Cabinet meets in Taipei; the pin is the government's seat.

sources.name: Focus Taiwan: Premier Cho calls for vigilance against cyberattacks ahead of elections
